{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
data = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check for missing values
missing_values = data.isnull().sum()

# Check unique sites
total_sites = data['site'].nunique()
list_of_sites = data['site'].unique()

# Check the 'responded' column for values
distribution_responded = data['responded'].value_counts()

missing_values, total_sites, list_of_sites, distribution_responded"}
